previous.changeLog:
- Fixed the constant right-and-down offset of drawings relative to the standard minimap.
- The overlay now uses the current minimap size correctly when entering battle and after the size is changed.
- Fixed arrowheads and perpendicular end markers on freehand strokes.
- Dashed and dotted styles now render continuously and evenly across freehand paths and circles.

current.changeLog:
Добавлено отображение тактических значков ТТ, СТ, ПТ-САУ, ЛТ и САУ на мини-карте.

Настройка ключа комнаты перенесена в стандартное окно настроек модификаций со значком шестерёнок.

Комплект состоит из четырёх отдельных файлов: WOT Tactic Bridge, ModsSettingsAPI, ModsListAPI и OpenWG Gameface. Убрано встраивание общих библиотек внутрь WOT Tactic, вызывавшее конфликт с отдельными компонентами меню.

Обновлено описание: добавлены ссылка на Discord-бота Tank Helper и инструкция подключения к комнате WOT Tactic.

previous.changeLog: Updated for World of Tanks 2.4. Fixed the game process sometimes staying open after you quit, especially on a fresh unlinked install. Overmatch now waits for you to click Link in the garage notification or mod settings instead of starting account linking automatically. Background checks and uploads no longer delay shutdown, and interrupted uploads retry the next time you play.

current.changeLog:
- Updated the installer for World of Tanks 2.4.0.1.
- Supporters can create highlights from a button below the battle rewards, when in-game requests are enabled.
- Get an in-game notification when your highlight is ready, with a link to watch it.
- The linked mod syncs your exact Marks of Excellence percentage, crew skills and equipment to your private Statistics and replay details.
- See your exact Marks of Excellence change for new Random Battles.
